Dear valued customer, we appreciate you bringing this matter to our attention and want to assure you that your report is being handled as a priority. We will review your case by Monday, 12 October 2026, and provide a response to your complaint by Friday, 30 October 2026. In the meantime, please block your card from the app, if not already done, to prevent any further unauthorized transactions. Additionally, please note that you should never share your codes or login details, even with someone claiming to work for VAULT. We appreciate your cooperation in this matter and will be in touch soon. Thank you for your patience and understanding.

Kind regards,
VAULT customer service
